risk_summary: R-01: All three upstream governance layers converged on block — phase_alignment_status (allowed=false), contract_compliance_verdict (allowed=false), runtime_boundary_verdict (boundary_violation_suspected). The change is governance-blocked at every layer.

R-02: Role-citation conflict unresolved — 6 of 8 checked claims in role_citation_verdict returned conflict_requires_block or role_mismatch. Zero strong architecture, governance, or scope claims have role-matched primary citations from SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md, DOCUMENTATION_VERIFICATION_MATRIX_v1.md, SYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION_RECORD_v1.md, or system-orchestration.yaml.

R-03: Constitutional document modification attempted without amendment authority — CLAUDE.md is the highest-priority interpretative authority (per its own preamble). Renaming its core architectural vocabulary ('Layer 2', 'Layer 3') is a constitutional amendment, not a documentation refactor. No constitutional amendment process citation was provided (role_citation_verdict C-05, C-07).

R-04: Unverified replacement terminology — claim c7 flags that 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' are new terms not present in any canonical document. Per CLAUDE.md Section 5.3, unverified claims do not count as proof. Per Section 16, claims untraceable to canonical sources must be treated as non-binding.

R-05: 'decision_layer' naming creates execution-boundary risk — CLAUDE.md Section 9 declares the system 'analysis-only' with no decision triggering. Section 10 forbids the claim 'Decisions are automated'. The term 'decision_layer' risks implying decision-making capability that the system explicitly prohibits. Phase_alignment_status blocked c2 specifically for this reason.

R-06: Canonical filename rename cascade — README_LAYER2.md is listed as a canonical current-state source in CLAUDE.md Section 2.1 and referenced by exact filename in at least 6 locations across the constitutional document. Renaming this file without cross-canonical coordination risks breaking the documentation authority chain.

R-07: Contract-affecting change requires full canonical review — CLAUDE.md Section 11 mandates review of all canonical documents for contract-affecting changes. This obligation cannot be satisfied while upstream canonical conflict is unresolved.

R-08: Phase alignment is ambiguous_requires_block — only c6 (fail-closed guard) was allowed_now. All other claims are blocked or deferred. live_readiness_implication_detected=true due to decision_layer naming. scope_exceeds_current_allowance=true.

R-09: No alias mapping provided for renamed terms or filenames — the rename proposes replacing established canonical vocabulary globally without any alias mapping, identity continuity plan, or reference update scope. This violates rename safety requirements.

R-10: Mixed scope blending — claim c2 blends current-state boundary language (snapshot contract, phase gates) with target-state components (planned Layer-3). A terminology rename that spans both scopes risks obscuring the current-vs-target distinction that CLAUDE.md Section 3 mandates.
notes: This is a content_change, not a rename_only change. The proposed replacement terms ('truth_store', 'decision_layer') are semantically distinct from the existing terms ('Layer 2', 'Layer 3') — they introduce new architectural vocabulary that has not been verified against canonical materials (claim c7, evidence_class: cannot_verify_from_current_materials). Per DR-11, a purported rename that alters semantic governance state must not be classified as rename_only.

The change affects the constitutional document (CLAUDE.md) itself — the highest-priority interpretative authority. This is not a documentation styling concern; it is a constitutional amendment that changes the vocabulary used throughout Sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 11, and 14.
All upstream governance steps have blocked this change. The blocked attempts are themselves governance events that must be resolved before any further action on this request.

The only compliant element in the entire request is the fail-closed guard (c6/C-06), which is ironically the signal that blocks the rest of the request. The system is correctly applying fail-closed behavior.
No target-state work has been described as current-state implementation in this assessment. Layer 3 remains 'planned only' per CLAUDE.md Section 3.2.
No documentation change has been described as proof of runtime behavior in this assessment.
README_LAYER2.md was treated as canonical within its declared collaborator-workflow role; it was not used as a primary authority for implementation-state, architecture, or limitations claims.
